text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you. Did you come all this way 
just to celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Also, here's a present for you. Would you 
like to guess what it is? Here's a hint: 
it's something you love, Eye-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Something I like... Could it perhaps be 
related to baths?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Handmade soap, bath bombs... 
What else could work...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Could a showerhead be a possibility too, I 
wonder? Would you give me the answer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Actually, when I went into the mountains 
the other day, I found the most wonderful 
waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's not hot water, so it'd just be a 
cold splash, but I think it will feel 
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I hold a Special Umamusume 
Hunting License for trapping and netting. 
Should a wild beast appear, I am fully 
capable of handling it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. I will protect you without 
fail, Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. But there's no need to 
protect me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, I will not 
lose. I gladly accept your invitation!
